figures.name: Padmasambhava

ability.name: Vajra Thunder
ability.description: Defeat one demon enemy permanently; grant all allies immunity to dark spirits for 2 turns.

figures.description: The Indian tantric master who subdued Tibet's demons and converted them to Buddhism's protective forces.

figures.name: Gesar of Ling

ability.name: Gesar's Lance
ability.description: Deal 8 damage to one evil enemy; summon one of Gesar's 18 warrior allies with 6/6/6/6/6 stats.

figures.description: The world's longest epic hero who descended from heaven to fight demons and establish the kingdom of Ling.

figures.name: Yama Dharmaraja

ability.name: Wheel of Karma
ability.description: Reduce all dark enemy defenses by 3 from karmic retribution.

figures.description: The Tibetan lord of death who holds the wheel of life in his teeth and judges all souls before rebirth.

figures.name: Tara (Tibetan)

ability.name: Swift Liberation
ability.description: React to any threat: prevent it from happening; grant +2 to all ally stats.

figures.description: The swift-acting bodhisattva with 21 forms ranging from green (active) to white (peaceful) liberation.

figures.name: Mahakala

ability.name: Black Cloak
ability.description: All dark protection abilities on your side are doubled in power for 1 turn.

figures.description: The great black protector deity with six arms who guards Buddhist and Bon practitioners from all harm.

figures.name: Milarepa (Tibetan)

ability.name: Cave Songs
ability.description: Sing enlightenment: remove all delusion effects; grant +3 wisdom to all allies.

figures.description: Tibet's greatest yogi who practiced in caves wearing only a thin cotton robe and achieved liberation.

figures.name: Nangsal Obum

ability.name: Death Return
ability.description: This card can be destroyed and return at half HP once per battle.

figures.description: The Tibetan heroine who died and returned to life, bringing teachings from the death realm.

figures.name: Tamdrin (Hayagriva)

ability.name: Horse Scream
ability.description: The scream of the horse head deals 5 sonic damage to all dark enemies; they are deafened.

figures.description: The horse-headed fierce deity who screams to terrify demons and is among the most wrathful protectors.

figures.name: Bon Dragon

ability.name: Dragon Wind
ability.description: Deal 3 damage to all enemies; grant all Bon allies +2 speed from dragon wind.

figures.description: The indigenous Tibetan Bon dragon who guards the sky and serves as mount for divine warriors.

figures.name: Drolma

ability.name: Green Liberator
ability.description: Remove all fear and hesitation effects from all allies; grant +2 magic.

figures.description: The specifically Tibetan Green Tara (Drolma) who liberates beings from danger with instant compassionate action.

figures.name: Dorje Shugden

ability.name: Protector's Wrath
ability.description: Prevent all interference with dharmic study; deal 3 damage to disrupting enemies.

figures.description: The controversial Gelugpa protector deity whose fierce power divides the Tibetan Buddhist community.

figures.name: Nechung Oracle

ability.name: Oracle Trance
ability.description: Enter trance: look at all enemy intentions for 2 turns.

figures.description: The Tibetan state oracle through whom the fierce protector spirit Pehar communicates divine guidance.

figures.name: Shinje Chogyal

ability.name: Mirror of Karma
ability.description: Show one enemy their karma: reduce their power by the number of dark actions they have taken.

figures.description: The peaceful aspect of Yama Dharmaraja who peacefully guides the judicious assessment of karma.

figures.name: Bardo Being

ability.name: Bardo State
ability.description: This card exists between two states: it can dodge one attack each turn from uncertainty of form.

figures.description: The wandering consciousness in the bardo state between death and rebirth seeking liberation or good rebirth.

figures.name: Jowo Shakyamuni

ability.name: Holy Presence
ability.description: All allies gain +1 to all stats while the Jowo is honored; remove one curse from all allies.

figures.description: The sacred Jowo image of the young Shakyamuni Buddha, Tibet's most sacred statue, housed in the Jokhang.

figures.name: Naga (Tibetan)

ability.name: Naga Treasure
ability.description: Steal one resource or buff from one enemy; restore 2 HP to one ally from the naga's hoard.

figures.description: The Tibetan lu (naga) who lives in water and earth, guarding treasure and causing disease when disturbed.

figures.name: Mountain Deity

ability.name: Mountain Shield
ability.description: All ally defense cannot be reduced below 5 while the mountain deity stands.

figures.description: The great Tibetan mountain deity Nyenchen Thanglha who governs the mountain ranges and protects Tibet.

figures.name: Drala

ability.name: Drala Invocation
ability.description: Invoke drala: grant one ally +2 to all stats from the warrior spirit's blessing.

figures.description: The Bon warrior spirits invoked before battle who elevate the practitioner's lungta (wind horse) energy.

figures.name: Pehar

ability.name: Five Kings
ability.description: Take five different actions in one turn, each for 1 damage, from the five Pehar forms.

figures.description: The spirit king of five forms who possesses the Nechung oracle and advises the Dalai Lamas.

figures.name: Chod Dakini

ability.name: Body Offering
ability.description: Sacrifice 4 HP to grant all allies +4 magic from the offering of ego and self.

figures.description: The dakini of the Chod practice who cuts through ego by offering the body to demons and thereby defeating them.
